question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.
sql:
-- Verify: check total number of countries and players involved
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker as player_id,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player_id,
        SUM(pr.match_runs) as total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pr.match_id) as matches_with_balls
    FROM player_runs pr
    GROUP BY pr.player_id
),
player_match_count AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as total_matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        CASE WHEN pmt.total_matches_played > 0 THEN 1.0 * pt.total_runs / pmt.total_matches_played ELSE NULL END as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_totals pt
    JOIN player_match_count pmt ON pt.player_id = pmt.player_id
    JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    COUNT(*) as num_players,
    AVG(avg_runs_per_match) as country_avg
FROM player_avg
WHERE avg_runs_per_match IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_avg DESC
